Interview Round (1st December 2023):
14 students were selected. Interviews were held at their Andheri office. We were told to reach the
office at 9 am. We had an intro session with the VP of R&D operations at Tracelink. There were 4
panels.
1st Round (30-40 minutes):
There were 2 interviewers and they started going through my resume. I was asked to write pseudo
code for reversing a string on paper and give the time complexity and I was able to do that
comfortably. He asked me to explain one of my projects and write the data models that were used
for it. Then they gave me 2 puzzles, I was not able to answer the 1st puzzle and I don’t remember it
properly, but it was related to dates and birthdays. 2nd puzzle was that a man climbs 4m and falls 3m
every day, how many days would that man take to climb out of the well of 50m? The answer is 47
days as he would climb 46m in 46 days and on 47th day he would climb 4 m and come out of the well.
Then they asked me to write a SQL query to find the employee with 2nd highest salary. I was unable
to do that so he told find the employee with the highest salary, then I was able to write that. As I had
mentioned about an internship, He asked me the difference between put and push API and I was
able to answer that. I had mentioned that I am a trek leader, one of the interviewers had some
knowledge about trekking, so we discussed trekking for about 5 minutes, then the interview ended.
2nd Round(30-40 minutes):
An hour after the 1st round, I was called for 2nd round. There was only 1 interviewer for this round. He
took my resume and asked about the project that we had created for the Pre-SIH hackathon. We
discussed the features and the problems that we had faced during the development. He asked
whether I knew about WordPress and told me to draw the table required for the database in my
opinion and also draw the UI on the board. Then he asked me some HR questions like tell your
qualities with examples, what are your future plans, etc. I was asked about trekking in this round as
well.
3rd Round(15 minutes):
After 30 minutes, I was called for the 3rd Round. The Interviewer was the same with whom we had
the intro session. He started by asking about my family background and went towards trekking. He
asked me what problems I had faced while leading groups on the trek. He also asked me about the
Community of Coders club of our college and my role in it.

The results were announced at around 7 pm and 3 students were selected and I was fortunate to be
among them.

Give contests on Leetcode, Codechef, Codeforces, etc it helps in coding rounds.

Keep at least 1 position of extracurricular activity.
